usage.callShape: POST https://stableenrich.dev/api/serper/shopping with JSON body {q, gl?, hl?, num?, location?, tbs?, safe?, page?, autocorrect?}
quirks: Only field q is required; all others (gl, hl, num, location, tbs, safe, page, autocorrect) are optional.
Results are in body.shopping[] (not body.organic[] which is the /search variant).
Each shopping item's imageUrl is a large inline base64 data:image/webp URI, bloating the response to ~160KB even for a single query. Strip/ignore imageUrl if you only need product data.

Registry surface URL https://stableenrich.dev/api/serper/shopping works directly; the x402.orth.sh/serper/shopping mirror is equivalent. x402 payment on Base; observed $0.04/call via the StableEnrich gateway.
usage.guide: POST to https://stableenrich.dev/api/serper/shopping with a JSON body containing at least {"q":"<product query>"} and pay the x402 prompt on Base ($0.04 USDC via the StableEnrich gateway). Read product results from body.shopping[] — each item has title, source, link, price, rating, ratingCount, productId, position, and a very large base64 imageUrl. Optionally narrow with gl (country), hl (language), num, location, or tbs. Expect a large response (~160KB) due to inline image data; ignore imageUrl if you only need product details.
